scope: Standalone synthetic planning prototype; no production app, account, backend, or deployment validation.

environment.fileUrl: Blocked by browser environment policy: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. Used local HTTP instead.
environment.network: Initial local HTML document request allowed. Additional network requests and storage API reads are audited.

checks.name: HTML inline JavaScript parses; no external resources or persistence/network APIs
Initial six unique checked dates and duplicate date are visible only on request
End-exclusive boundary counts Oct 2 and Oct 5 but excludes Oct 7
Invalid, equal, reversed and empty periods do not open a review; empty target selection is rejected
Monthly and direct intent link existing targets without changing original days, checks, progress or deadline; duplicate link is not added
Empty weekday edit preserves unchecked input, original weekdays and checks; valid change does not rewrite old check dates
Past Wednesday correction works after Tuesday/Thursday rule change; cancel preserves both duplicates and confirm removes all for exact date only
Duplicate check is not added; future/empty/off-rule dates are rejected; valid past Tuesday can be checked
Current goal progress is presented separately from period check dates
Optional note and snapshot are explicitly saved; viewing alone creates no saved review
Changing current plan, checks and goal leaves the saved snapshot and note unchanged
Reading without saving ends normally and does not add a review; returning preserves current session only
Keyboard can open/close correction dialog and focus returns to exact correction control
Reload resets plans, relationships, checks, progress and saved reviews
No secondary network request, storage API access, console error or uncaught error
Empty judgment saves successfully; a second review preserves the first snapshot

initialFindings.detail: Exclusive end date display corrected to show actual endExclusive; empty weekday edit rejected without mutation.
Native dialog returnValue is reset on each open so Escape after an earlier confirm cannot remove a different check.
First run read DOM immediately after dialog form close; assertion now waits for exact corrected row removal before checking remaining dates.

limitations: Synthetic UI interactions and Linux Chromium viewport checks only; not actual Apple device validation.
No account sync, backend write, concurrency, authenticated ownership or file restore implementation is simulated.
Application logic, production data and deployment are unchanged.

manualVisualReview.findings: All three screenshots read directly. Korean text and date-boundary labels are legible. No clipping/overlap or horizontal overflow. Initial controls stay in one column; reading and preserved/current comparison remain in the same white surface.
